stemMd: Hagia Sophia in Istanbul was constructed in which century in its celebrated surviving monumental form?
explanationMd: UNESCO identifies Hagia Sophia as a sixth-century monument. It belongs to the Byzantine architectural context. Its construction date must be distinguished from later changes in use.

distractorRationale.c: This is the era of the Parthenon, not Hagia Sophia.
distractorRationale.a: This is the period of the Süleymaniye Mosque.
distractorRationale.b: The principal monument is much older.
distractorRationale.e: Modern changes do not date its construction.
